title: No Training Wheels: Steering Vectors for Bias Correction at Inference Time

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset where hair color classification is spuriously correlated with gender, and mitigating the bias by ablating steering vectors derived from activation differences between male and female groups.

Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the UTKFace dataset where gender classification is spuriously correlated with age, and mitigating the bias by ablating steering vectors derived from activation differences between age groups.

Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset where bird classification is spuriously correlated with image backgrounds (water vs. land), and mitigating the bias using directional ablation of bias vectors.

Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the MultiNLI dataset where textual entailment contradiction labels are spuriously correlated with the presence of negation words, and mitigating the bias using directional ablation.
